title: The Mortgage Payoff Trap
hook_text: PAYING OFF YOUR MORTGAGE EARLY IS A TRAP

beats.say: Throwing extra cash at a low-interest mortgage feels smart. It's actually costing you hundreds of thousands.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a tiny felt house with a wool yarn chimney sitting alone on a green felt hill, a single dark thread tied to its door, warm tungsten glow

beats.say: That fixed rate debt is cheap. Meanwhile, missing out on compounding interest destroys your net worth.
beats.visual: Macro close-up of stitched felt door seam with a tiny wool padlock, visible fibers, razor-thin focus on one red stitch, handmade set

beats.say: Take investing $500 a month at 8% a year. In 30 years, it grows into $745,180.
beats.visual: Overhead view of a towering felt mountain built from layered cream felt sheets of mortgage paper, tiny felt climber seen only from behind near the base, soft light

beats.say: If you send that money to the bank instead, you save a tiny 3% or 4% interest rate.
beats.visual: Low angle looking up a tall wool ladder with several rungs missing, rungs of braided yarn, felt clouds above, dramatic tungsten rim light

beats.say: You're trading a massive compounding return for a tiny guaranteed savings.
beats.visual: Long lens compression of a row of identical felt houses with wool chimneys, one house glowing amber while the rest sit gray, shallow depth of field

beats.say: Look at the math. In 40 years, that same $500 a month turns into $1,745,504.
beats.visual: Side view of a felt trapdoor set into a wool-stitched floor, slightly ajar with a warm glow from below, a felt lever beside it

beats.say: That house is paid off, but your overall wealth is miles behind where it could be.
beats.visual: Aerial overhead of two felt paths over green felt hills, one short and dull gray, the other winding long and growing into a golden wool tree, handmade diorama

beats.say: Inflation also eats away at that debt. Your fixed payment shrinks in real buying power every single year.
beats.visual: Macro of a stitched felt vault door with a wool dial and thick yarn bolts, one bolt pulled free, soft fibers catching warm light

beats.say: So what's the better rule? Never rush to crush cheap debt.
beats.visual: Eye level through a felt doorway of a tiny wool piggy-like hill, a felt clockwork gear turning slowly and shrinking a stack of felt blocks, tungsten light

beats.say: Keep the low rate, pocket the spread, and let compounding do the heavy lifting.
beats.visual: Overhead of a felt seesaw balanced on a wool spool, a small gray felt block on one end and a large golden felt tree on the other, shallow depth of field

beats.say: Because holding cheap debt while investing the difference is exactly how
beats.visual: Wide dusk shot of a small felt house garden where a wool seedling grows into a tall yarn tree beside the chimney, felt stars, warm calm light

caption: The math behind cheap debt beats the emotional comfort of a zero balance every single time. #mortgage #personalfinance #wealth #investing
description: Paying off a low-interest mortgage early often destroys long-term wealth through missed compounding opportunities. Here is the comparative math behind cheap debt.
first_comment: Would you rather have a paid-off house or a bigger investment portfolio at age 65?
look: stop motion felt and wool craft, visible fibers, handmade set, warm tungsten light, shallow depth of field
